content.text: Miss Dona, adult family home owner
New message from Miss Dona's Home
Open ShiftKind to read and reply.

No agents. No fees.
Just the shift.
Meet Lydia, a caregiver in Washington State.
She once paid an agent a fee to find her work.
The work never came, and the agent stopped answering.
Miss Dona runs an adult family home.
Agencies took a large cut on every shift she filled.
Home licenses and caregiver credentials are checked,
so both sides know who they are dealing with.
Lydia sees the real home, the hours,
the pay and the distance before she applies.
She marks the days and nights she is free, down to a single date.
Miss Dona posts a shift in a minute,
and sees who is free, with photos, credentials and ratings.
and a phone alert means no reply is missed.
Each rates the other, so good work gets known.
